description: This Dart source file defines the AppDatabase class, responsible for managing local SQLite database operations for download metadata, watch history, and a download queue. It includes methods to open the database, create tables, upsert watch progress, retrieve watch position, and close the database.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Manages SQLite database connection, schema creation, and data operations for download and watch history data.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the database, creating tables if necessary.

methods.name: upsertWatchProgress
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a watch position for a specific content ID.

methods.name: getWatchProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the last saved watch position in seconds for a specific content ID.
